nfci.title: Chicago Fed National Financial Conditions Index (NFCI)
nfci.units: Index (0 = average financial conditions; positive = tighter than average)
nfci.source: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago (NFCI) via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)

anfci.title: Chicago Fed Adjusted National Financial Conditions Index (ANFCI)
anfci.units: Index (0 = average financial conditions; positive = tighter than average)
anfci.source: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago (ANFCI) via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)

nfci_risk.title: NFCI risk subindex
nfci_risk.units: Index (0 = average financial conditions; positive = tighter than average)
nfci_risk.source: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago (NFCIRISK) via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)

nfci_credit.title: NFCI credit subindex
nfci_credit.units: Index (0 = average financial conditions; positive = tighter than average)
nfci_credit.source: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago (NFCICREDIT) via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)

nfci_leverage.title: NFCI leverage subindex
nfci_leverage.units: Index (0 = average financial conditions; positive = tighter than average)
nfci_leverage.source: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago (NFCILEVERAGE) via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)

nfci_nonfin_leverage.title: NFCI nonfinancial leverage subindex
nfci_nonfin_leverage.units: Index (0 = average financial conditions; positive = tighter than average)
nfci_nonfin_leverage.source: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago (NFCINONFINLEVERAGE) via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)

stlfsi.title: St. Louis Fed Financial Stress Index
stlfsi.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (STLFSI4) via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)

kcfsi.title: Kansas City Financial Stress Index
kcfsi.source: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City (KCFSI) via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)

vix.title: CBOE Volatility Index (VIX), quarterly average
vix.source: Chicago Board Options Exchange (VIXCLS) via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)

baa_aaa.title: Moody's Baa minus Aaa corporate bond yield
baa_aaa.source: Moody's (BAA, AAA) via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis); author's calculation

baa_10y.title: Moody's Baa corporate bond yield minus the 10-year Treasury yield
baa_10y.source: Moody's (BAA) and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (GS10) via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis); author's calculation

term_spread.title: 10-year Treasury yield minus the 3-month Treasury bill rate
term_spread.source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (GS10, TB3MS) via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis); author's calculation

gz_spread.title: Gilchrist–Zakrajšek credit spread
gz_spread.source: Gilchrist and Zakrajšek (2012), updated by the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

ebp.title: Excess bond premium
ebp.source: Gilchrist and Zakrajšek (2012), updated by the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

y.label: Output (real GDP)
y.source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (GDPC1) via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)
